Message from Our CEO

The vision that shaped SoftBank

The term ASI - Artificial Super Intelligence-

may still be untamiliar to some. While Al,

or artiticial intelligence, is already widely

known, ASI refers to artificial intelligence

that surpasses the numan brain, as the term

"super" suggests. Although ASI has now

become an accepted and common term in

the industry, I have believed in this concept

tor the past 50 years. From the moment I

first saw that photo of the microcomputer

chip, I felt certain that humanity would one

day witness the emergence of intelligence

beyond its own. That belief has never

wavered and has been at the foundation of

SoftBank. We have always aimed to lead the

Intormation Revolution and bring happiness

to everyone. And among our goals, none

shines brighter than the realization of ASI.

That is why I feel compelled to share this

belief once again. I feel strongly that the

moment has finally come to discuss the

tuture in earnest.

Over the years, we have strategically and

frequently pivoted our business focus. And

each time, we faced criticism for being

unclear about our direction or perceived as

likely to go out of business soon. However,

looking back on our journey, it is clear our
